bullets.text: RedVDS Cybercrime Uncovered - **Microsoft** disrupts a major virtual desktop provider fueling global cybercriminal operations.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Released - New build 28020.1371 introduces fixes and improvements for Insiders.
Microsoft Leads in AI Governance - Recognized as a leader in IDC MarketScape for unified AI governance platforms.
CES 2026 Showcases Innovations - **Microsoft** highlights new Windows 11 PCs and AI advancements at CES.
Open to Work Book Launched - **Microsoft** and LinkedIn unveil a guide on navigating AI's impact on careers.
Privacy and Security Synergy - **Microsoft** emphasizes the integration of privacy and security in its services.
Windows 11 Insider Build Update - New features and improvements rolled out in build 26220.7535 for Insiders.
Xbox Developer_Direct Returns - **Xbox** celebrates its 25th anniversary with a broadcast on upcoming games.
